title: kubeconfig: credentials held by file reference, or absent
summary: Fragments of a kubeconfig users section where the credential is a path (tokenFile, client-certificate, client-key) or the user entry has no authentication fields at all.
rationale: These sit next to the inline forms with the same key names (token versus tokenFile, client-key-data versus client-key). A path names where the secret lives and contains none; an empty user holds nothing. Reporting either punishes keeping the secret out of the file. The fragments hold only a users section so that no server or certificate field, whose sensitivity is unresolved, is asserted.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. client-go documents tokenFile as a pointer to a file that contains a bearer token, client-key and client-certificate as paths to files, and marks every AuthInfo field optional; Kubernetes states that file and path references are relative to the kubeconfig's location. The value is a path, not the content of the file it names.

sources.supports: TokenFile is a pointer to a file that contains a bearer token; ClientKey is the path to a client key file for TLS; ClientCertificate is the path to a client cert file for TLS; each AuthInfo field is +optional.
File and path references in a kubeconfig file are relative to the location of the kubeconfig file.
